name: carry
description: Move this agent: backups (carry_fold, carry_unfold), to another computer (carry_land / carry_fly on this network; a server on the internet: carry_new_land_secret, then carry_fly with host and secret), onto another disk or stick (carry_to_disk, carry_to_flash, carry_morph), OS updates (carry_update, carry_rescue), an offline disk check and repair (carry_fsck). Choose devices with bash lsblk. force=true and anything that erases only after the user says yes.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|back up this computer -> discover(path='mcp/carry', enable=true); carry_fold()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|the code on both screens is 482193 -> carry_confirm(code='482193')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|install onto the Samsung disk beside Windows on sda5 -> bash lsblk; carry_to_disk(disk='/dev/sda', partition='/dev/sda5')

root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|set up my VPS 203.0.113.7 (ssh key in ~/.ssh) as a land and fly there -> carry_new_land_secret(host='203.0.113.7'); bash ssh root@203.0.113.7 'hostname; findmnt -no SOURCE /; lsblk -d'; bash ssh root@203.0.113.7 'curl -fsSL …/takeover.sh | bash -s -- --land --land-secret <secret> --yes --wipe /dev/vda --reboot'; carry_fly(host='203.0.113.7', timeout_secs=1800)

root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|the server 198.51.100.9 waits in land mode, its secret is in land-198.51.100.9 -> secrets_get(name='land-198.51.100.9'); carry_fly(host='198.51.100.9', secret='<secret>')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|df says Bad message, dmesg shows EXT4 checksum errors -> tell root it reboots for a few minutes; carry_fsck()
